description: Deposit money into your wallet via a single hosted checkout. Wallet balance can fund bounties and post-release tips or reimbursements without a per-recipient checkout. Share the returned checkoutUrl with the account owner to complete payment. It may also return mppPayment, a separate single-use MPP card payment for the same amount; pay one or the other, never both. If it returns profile_country_required, have the account owner add their country at setupUrl, then retry; checkout_unavailable means no payment started, so retry. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

amount.description: Amount to deposit in USD, from 1 to 10,000.
amount.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10000)
